title: 洛杉磯區域連接線~Los Angeles Regional Connector
focus: 市中心輕軌連通線路網重整與轉乘~Downtown light rail connector network reconfiguration and transfers
summary: 以洛杉磯區域連接線把既有路線貫通的背景，建立服務路徑重新組合的教學案例。學徒比較少一次轉乘與核心區段增班的不同效果，檢查合流進路、月台交換、地下站排水和施工交接如何共同決定實際效益。~Use the Los Angeles Regional Connector to construct a teaching case about through-running and reconfigured service paths. Compare the benefit of removing one transfer with that of increasing frequency in the central section. Examine how merge routes, platform exchange, underground drainage and construction handback jointly determine the realised passenger benefit, rather than assuming a shorter route diagram guarantees shorter journeys.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 margin=73.2 s；單元 2 得 catch_time=1212 s；單元 3 得 combinations=256 states。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 distance 的擾動測試，結果改為 55.02 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以洛杉磯區域連接線把既有路線貫通的背景，建立服務路徑重新組合的教學案例。學徒比較少一次轉乘與核心區段增班的不同效果，檢查合流進路、月台交換、地下站排水和施工交接如何共同決定實際效益。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives margin=73.2 s; unit 2 gives catch_time=1212 s; unit 3 gives combinations=256 states. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing distance in the first unit changes its result to 55.02 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Los Angeles Regional Connector to construct a teaching case about through-running and reconfigured service paths. Compare the benefit of removing one transfer with that of increasing frequency in the central section. Examine how merge routes, platform exchange, underground drainage and construction handback jointly determine the realised passenger benefit, rather than assuming a shorter route diagram guarantees shorter journeys. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2014 年：區域連接線取得聯邦資金協議推進建設；2023 年：洛杉磯區域連接線於六月開放旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以洛杉磯區域連接線把既有路線貫通的背景，建立服務路徑重新組合的教學案例。學徒比較少一次轉乘與核心區段增班的不同效果，檢查合流進路、月台交換、地下站排水和施工交接如何共同決定實際效益。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2014: The Regional Connector secured a federal funding agreement advancing construction; 2023: The Los Angeles Regional Connector opened to passengers in June. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Los Angeles Regional Connector to construct a teaching case about through-running and reconfigured service paths. Compare the benefit of removing one transfer with that of increasing frequency in the central section. Examine how merge routes, platform exchange, underground drainage and construction handback jointly determine the realised passenger benefit, rather than assuming a shorter route diagram guarantees shorter journeys. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 比較原先轉乘步行和等待與貫通列車旅程中的剩餘時間。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Compare former transfer walking and waiting with remaining time in a through-running journey.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=181.8 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=73.2 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 199.98 m，其餘固定，結果為 55.02 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=181.8 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=73.2 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 199.98 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 55.02 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 快慢車追及與待避~Fast-slow train catch-up
units.title: 快慢車追及與待避~Fast-slow train catch-up
units.mechanism: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 讓不同端點列車在共同地下段競爭進入時刻。~Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration. The meeting point is not a permitted safe separation between trains. Catch-up time depends on starting separation and relative speed, not only the faster train’s speed. If either train stops or encounters signalling constraints, use piecewise speed functions and restore route occupation to the event diagram. Make trains from different outer termini compete for entry into the common underground section.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12120 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1212 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13332 m，其餘固定，結果為 1333.2 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12120 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1212 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13332 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1333.2 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded.
units.verify: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 以逐站到發時刻重建距離時間圖，核對起始間隔和各段速度，並標示待避占用。~Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Rebuild a distance-time diagram from station arrivals and departures, verifying initial separation and segment speeds and marking passing occupation.
units.failure: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。~Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case.
units.misconception: 快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量~Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
units.practice: 增加慢車停站與快車出發延後各一個情境，畫出時空圖，討論待避線能解決的衝突與仍存在的交叉進路限制。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 catch_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a slow-train stop and a delayed fast departure as separate cases, draw time-distance diagrams, and distinguish conflicts solved by a loop from remaining crossing-route restrictions. Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 在連接既有線的位置建立進路互斥和釋放條件。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Establish route exclusions and release conditions at connections to existing lines.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=8 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=256 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 9 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 512 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=8 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=256 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 9 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 512 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.title: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.mechanism: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 以核心段逐班服務量檢查增班後真正可用的運能。~Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Check actual usable capacity from successive central-section services after frequency increases.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=181.8 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17821.78 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 199.98 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16201.62 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=181.8 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17821.78 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 199.98 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16201.62 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.
units.verify: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。~Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.
units.failure: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。~A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.
units.misconception: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半~Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
units.practice: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.title: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.mechanism: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 分析乘客路徑改變是否讓原本較輕的車門變成瓶頸。~Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Analyse whether changed passenger paths make previously lightly used doors become bottlenecks.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=242 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.60417 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 267至 267 persons，其餘固定，結果為 25.90625 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=242 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.60417 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 267, to 267 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 25.90625 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。~Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.
units.failure: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。~Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery.
units.misconception: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異~Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
units.practice: 將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.title: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 在新舊線定位參考切換時保留誤差和狀態紀錄。~Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Retain error and state records when localisation references change between new and existing sections.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.04 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.79239 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.444 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.823812 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.04 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.79239 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.444 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.823812 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。~Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.
units.failure: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。~A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.
units.misconception: 兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差~Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
units.practice: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.title: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.mechanism: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 用地下站入口集水建立泵浦停機時的體積平衡。~A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Build a volume balance for underground station-entrance runoff during pump downtime.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.02e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.30906 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.222e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.339966 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.02e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.30906 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.222e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.339966 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.
units.verify: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。~Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation.
units.failure: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。~Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.
units.misconception: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位~A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
units.practice: 將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.mechanism: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 比較施工前後同一測點剖面，避免基準更換造成假位移。~Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Compare identical survey profiles before and after construction to avoid apparent displacement from changed datums.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01212 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.606 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013332 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.6666 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01212 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.606 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013332 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.6666 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.
units.verify: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。~Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
units.failure: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。~A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.
units.misconception: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷~Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
units.practice: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 施工窗口與可完成工作量~Possession window and achievable work
units.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量~Possession window and achievable work
units.mechanism: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。 可施工時間等於總窗口扣掉保護設置、測試及還路等必要活動。這些活動可能有不可重疊的安全依賴；趕工不能直接刪除，應以資源和先後順序改變排程。 把交接窗口中的測試與還路時間列為必要工序。~A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path. Coordination of dependencies may matter more than nominal production speed. Usable work time equals the possession window minus protection, testing and handback activities. These can have nonoverlapping safety dependencies and cannot simply be deleted to accelerate work. Change scheduling through resources and legitimate task order. Treat testing and handback time as necessary tasks within a commissioning possession.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 49.995 min，其餘固定，結果為 540.02 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 49.995 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 540.02 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded.
units.verify: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。~Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available.
units.failure: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。~Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time.
units.misconception: 施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量~The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
units.practice: 增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕~Merging flow and bottleneck margin
units.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕~Merging flow and bottleneck margin
units.mechanism: 兩支線人流或列車流匯入同一通道時，總需求需與下游服務率比較。差值為正只代表平均有餘裕，突發到達仍會形成隊列；服務率降低時積壓以需求和服務的差累積。 容量減去兩支流給出平均服務餘裕，負值表示隊列會累積而非負人數。此代數式不描述人群密度與速度的關係；要算實際隊列長度，必須把淨流量隨時間積分。 把兩個出站方向匯入共同通道的流量與出口容量相減。~When two passenger or train streams merge, their combined demand must be compared with downstream service. Positive average margin does not prevent queues after bursts. If service falls below demand, backlog accumulates at the difference between their rates. Capacity minus two incoming streams gives mean service margin; a negative value indicates accumulating queues, not negative people. This algebra does not describe the density-speed relationship. Physical queue length requires integrating net flow over time. Subtract two merging exit flows from the capacity of their shared downstream passage.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45.45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min；計算：margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=19.55 persons/min。敏感度：flow1 單獨增加百分之十至 49.995 persons/min，其餘固定，結果為 15.005 persons/min。模型邊界：定常平均流量；不包含隨機到達、優先權和實體隊列長度。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45.45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min; calculation: margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=19.55 persons/min. Sensitivity: flow1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 49.995 persons/min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.005 persons/min. Model boundary: Steady mean flows; random arrivals, priority rules and physical queue length are excluded.
units.verify: 同時記錄兩個入口和下游出口，將資料用相同時間窗聚合，檢查需求尖峰是否被過大的平均窗隱藏。 同步量測兩入口與出口流量，採相同時間窗並以人數守恆核對區域內隊列的增減。~Record both inlets and the downstream outlet synchronously, aggregate with equal windows, and check whether long averaging periods hide demand peaks. Measure both inlet flows and outlet flow synchronously, use identical time windows, and check queue changes through conservation of people.
units.failure: 一支線延誤後集中釋放會造成瞬時過載，即使全天平均需求較小；下游出口短暫阻塞則可能向上游回堵。 平均餘裕為正仍可能短時超載，須核對脈衝到達。~A delayed branch can release a concentrated surge despite modest daily demand; a brief downstream blockage can spill a queue back upstream. Positive mean margin can coexist with short overloads; inspect pulsed arrivals.
units.misconception: 平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊~Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time.
units.practice: 保持平均需求相同但把一支線改成脈衝到達，逐分鐘更新隊列，提出分流或節流措施並檢查其上游影響。 再以本單元 flow1 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Keep mean demand fixed while making one branch arrive in pulses, update the queue minute by minute, and assess upstream consequences of rerouting or metering. Also recalculate margin for the alternative flow1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

教學假設，單元 3：inputs=8 Boolean inputs，計算 combinations=256 states；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: inputs=8 Boolean inputs, calculated combinations=256 states; not measured performance.
